headline: Kennedy School traffic and bike items, Highland Ave temporary paving update, and a lower-cost driveway parking permit.
summary: The agenda lists items on drop-off and pick-up at the Kennedy School, including bike lanes, bike racks, and signage. It also covers a possible driveway parking permit, an update on Highland Ave temporary paving, and a review of traffic around schools citywide.
items: Director of Parking report on item 26-1019 (ID 26-1090)
Lower-cost parking permit for vehicle owners with driveways, daytime and evening street parking only, not usable during street cleaning or snow emergencies (ID 26-1019)
Paint bike markings in the Elm Street bike lane across from the Kennedy School (ID 26-1424)
Add bike racks at the Kennedy School (ID 26-1423)
Install drop-off/pick-up signage on Cherry Street across from the Kennedy School (ID 26-1422)
Update on Highland Ave temporary paving (ID 26-1053)
Review of traffic flows and enforcement around schools citywide during drop-off and pick-up (ID 26-0917)
